one_off_receipts.what: Tasly contingent milestone payment (first patient dosed in REFRaME), net of withholding tax, received in Q3 2023
one_off_receipts.quote: During the three months ended September 30, 2023, we received a $5.0 million contingent payment from Tasly related to the first patient dosed in our REFRaME trial for luvelta, net of withholding tax of $0.5 million.
